name: How Am I A Vampire?!
source:
Tia just woke up with a massive hangover- and some sharp teeth! They couldn't break skin that easily last night..

She's sure she's become a vampire but how? Who did it?


Go around asking her friends what they know..

and maybe, if you have time

You can ask her crush too <3

[From [url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/how-am-i-a-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
